unit: One final-human-confirmed statistical candidate, not one unique underlying defect or paper.
selection: Copied final human-reviewed workbook labels: retain, statistical_results, confirmed_issue; frozen report relationship S_C or S_W.
provenance: Notes were authored in earlier R_Bulun Claude Opus 5.5 high AI reviewer runs. Subsequent human-reviewed copied workbook labels are authoritative for selection and substantive status. This coding is semantic analysis of those earlier Notes, not independent verification of trial errors.

categories.label_zh: 计数、百分比与人群分母
categories.inclusion: Counts, percentages, denominators, totals, missingness accounting, or population-stage counts fail to reconcile.
categories.exclusion_and_boundary: Includes local percent/decimal typos and mislabeled analysis-stage counts. Excludes an identified row/group/outcome transfer (ATTRIBUTION), and score-scale definitions (ANALYSIS_DEFINITION).

categories.inclusion: The effect estimate, its construction, scale, or identity is inconsistent or insufficiently specified; includes ratios asserted in the Notes to be nonestimable.
categories.exclusion_and_boundary: Includes RR versus OR, transposed/pooled risks, SMD construction, effect-scale transformation and point-estimate typos. Excludes pure contrast sign (DIRECTION), isolated uncertainty bounds (INTERVAL_DISPERSION), and direct row swaps (ATTRIBUTION).

categories.label_zh: 区间与分布摘要的数值一致性
categories.inclusion: Confidence/credible intervals or distribution summaries have inconsistent bounds, order, location, precision, width, or cross-location values.
categories.exclusion_and_boundary: Includes interval-endpoint sign/decimal typos and impossible median/IQR relations. Excludes diagnosed confidence-level/method misdefinition (ANALYSIS_DEFINITION); a central CI/P significance conflict is TEST_INFERENCE unless a localized bound defect is explicitly resolved.

categories.inclusion: Printed P values fail to reproduce, disagree with intervals, or contradict significance/decision-rule statements in the narrative.
categories.exclusion_and_boundary: Includes false no-significance summaries and count of cases meeting a statistical decision rule. Excludes diagnosed undisclosed mixed methods (ANALYSIS_DEFINITION) and an otherwise correct inference with reversed directional wording (DIRECTION).

categories.inclusion: The point-estimate sign, contrast order, favorable axis, inequality wording, or benefit/harm interpretation conflicts with the numerical contrast.
categories.exclusion_and_boundary: Includes a locally dropped point sign regardless of severity. Excludes an isolated interval-endpoint sign (INTERVAL_DISPERSION) and transfers between treatment columns or outcome rows (ATTRIBUTION).

categories.inclusion: The Notes identify values assigned to the wrong arm, outcome, row, or categorical bin, or copied from a different identified row/panel.
categories.exclusion_and_boundary: A specifically identified source-to-destination mapping takes precedence over generic count, CI, or P inconsistency. Excludes population-stage naming alone (COUNT_DENOM), estimate/scale names (EFFECT_ESTIMAND), or merely suspected transfers with no specific mapping.

categories.inclusion: Conflicting or missing definitions of models, tests, predictors, censoring, eligibility, confidence levels, priors, summary statistics, units, or questionnaire scoring.
categories.exclusion_and_boundary: Includes explicitly diagnosed method/level mismatch even when first noticed via CI/P discordance. Effect-estimator identity goes to EFFECT_ESTIMAND; arithmetic analysis-population accounting goes to COUNT_DENOM.

primary_selection_rules: Read the full Notes, including negation and qualifying explanations; titles supply context only. Do not import judgments.json or other rationales.
Choose the mechanism supported by the retained claim. Successful comparator rows and rejected broader allegations are not issues to be coded.
A specifically identified row, arm, outcome, or bin transfer takes ATTRIBUTION over a generic numeric discrepancy; mere suspected copying does not.
Point-contrast sign or benefit interpretation takes DIRECTION; isolated interval-endpoint signs remain INTERVAL_DISPERSION.
Population-stage counts and headers remain COUNT_DENOM; effect-estimator/scale identity is EFFECT_ESTIMAND; model/test/scoring/summary-statistic identity is ANALYSIS_DEFINITION.
An explicitly diagnosed confidence-level or CI/P method mismatch takes ANALYSIS_DEFINITION over a generic inferential contradiction.

For genuinely independent issues bundled in one candidate, choose the central retained issue from the full note, record secondary mechanisms and multiple_issues, and lower confidence where primary selection remains contestable.
Local transcription/formatting is a secondary tag; it does not replace a statistical mechanism category or determine severity.
If no supported primary mechanism is recoverable, use UNCLASSIFIABLE with the reason. Do not infer a category from a title alone.
substantive_status: Copied without change from final human-reviewed labels; never inferred from category, wording, or confidence.

confidence.high: Mechanism is directly supported by the full Notes; certainty concerns classification, not truth of the alleged trial error.
confidence.medium: Primary choice has competing mechanisms or relies on an explicitly tentative diagnostic mapping.
confidence.low: Mechanism is weakly supported; retain explicit uncertainty rather than invent specificity.

secondary_tags: Optional descriptive tags may overlap. They are not mutually exclusive issue counts and must not be summed as candidates.
limitations: Candidate records may overlap in underlying cause, especially explicitly linked candidates.
Four sampled publication years are available, not a continuous annual series.
Counts profile confirmed candidate records and do not estimate prevalence among all trials.
A narrative explanation in an earlier AI note is evidence for coding its meaning, not newly verified evidence of a trial error.
